item.title: Case study: Spring Boot, OpenTelemetry, and Datadog as code
item.description:
This is a condensed case study of spring-datadog-lab: five Spring Boot services, one OTLP pipeline, two backends, and a login flow that fans out over Kafka.

Everything below comes from one real trace — 49d718ae…f238a3c3 — captured in the lab and visible in both Jaeger and Datadog.

Start with the trace, not the architecture

Read the header first: 526ms duration, 4 services, depth 7, 15 spans.
